15078|07df529b.name: Jang
15078|07df529b.text:
Fishmaster Bassbait has had the waters here seeded with high quality tastyfish so he can have his weekly tournament.

Me? I'm here to hand out the prizes! Whether you win or simply have a few tastyfish to spare, I'm your gal.

205729|0fc62dd3.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|0fc62dd3.text: A fellow disciple of the subtle arts, I see. Perhaps there is something I can teach you.

217412|889fad07.name: Amaryllis Webb
217412|889fad07.text: I can't chat for long, $c. My subjects require constant observation.

267806|6f7f9937.name: "Flipfin"
267806|6f7f9937.text:
Psst! Hey, you! Yeah, you! You caught one of those rare tournament fish, didn't you? Don't be shy, I can smell it from here!

Listen, I know what it's like to reel in your last line, thinking you're about to claim your prize... only to catch the most amazing, gorgeous, WORTHLESS lunker known to goblin kind! Yeah, been there, lost my shot at the title three weeks in a row to that! Learned pretty darn quick they taste better than the tastyfish, though.

Now, I just participate for fun. That means I've got a few tastyfish on hand... and I am willing to trade for the vastly superior rare fish.

Seems like a win-win for you, huh?

3373|43457c57.name: Arnok
3373|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

1088-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-progress.text: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
1088-progress.title: Ordanus

1089-progress.name: Unknown
1089-progress.text: Three keyholes are carved into the stone.
1089-progress.title: The Den

1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6395-complete.name: Novice Elreth
6395-complete.text: You have done a good deed today, $N.  Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place. As a token of my gratitude, please take one of these manuals I found.
6395-complete.title: Marla's Last Wish

6543-progress.name: Kadrak
6543-progress.text: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
6543-progress.title: The Warsong Reports

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6701-progress.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6701-progress.text:
We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!

We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.

Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.

Start at Durnholde, south of here.
6701-progress.title: Syndicate Emblems

7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

8193-progress.name: Riggle Bassbait
8193-progress.text:
Every Sunday, we have a contest to determine the greatest anglers of them all! Just be among the FIRST 50 PEOPLE to bring me some Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coasts of Stranglethorn and you will be declared a Master Angler!

If you're too slow, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for some Tastyfish you bring her.

Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly, so don't even think about holding onto them for next week!
8193-progress.title: Master Angler

8224-progress.text:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Dezian Queenfish, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*
8224-progress.title: Rare Fish - Dezian Queenfish

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the $r people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

91900-progress.name: Dokimi
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

96658-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96658-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96658-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96779-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96779-accept.text:
Sometimes, $r, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779-accept.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96779-complete.name: Myrokos Silentform
96779-complete.text:
With Tomas dead, Durnholde Keep will no doubt be destabilized. Lowly thugs of the Syndicate's kind often fall to disarray without a figurehead to lead them.

Good work, $N. I may call upon you for future missions.
96779-complete.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96781-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96781-accept.text:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781-accept.title: What's the Big Idea?

96783-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96783-accept.text:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783-accept.title: A Way In

96783-complete.name: Unknown
96783-complete.text: <Taking the uniform, you ready yourself for the next part of your mission.>
96783-complete.title: A Way In

96784-accept.name: Unknown
96784-accept.text: <You recall Myrokos' instructions to find out about an important deal going on with the Syndicate in Stromgarde Keep. With your disguise, you should be able to talk to members of the Syndicate somewhat freely. Surely, one of them knows something.>
96784-accept.title: Master of Disguise

96784-complete.name: Anastasia Miller
96784-complete.text:
<Anastasia's eyes narrow with suspicion.>

...how exactly do you know about the deal?
96784-complete.title: Master of Disguise

96785-accept.name: Anastasia Miller
96785-accept.text:
Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.

I'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
96785-accept.title: Ain't No Telling

96785-complete.name: Anastasia Miller
96785-complete.text:
Why you...where did you find that!?

<Anastasia takes a moment to compose herself.>

Fine. I'll tell you about the deal. Just give me that back, and we'll call it even.
96785-complete.title: Ain't No Telling

96785-progress.name: Anastasia Miller
96785-progress.text: I told you already, I've got nothing for you. Now beat it!
96785-progress.title: Ain't No Telling

96786-accept.name: Anastasia Miller
96786-accept.text:
Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.

That's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
96786-accept.title: The Syndicate Sting

96786-complete.name: Myrokos Silentform
96786-complete.text:
Well well, you seem to have acquired this through no small effort. You play the game of subterfuge well.

If you are wondering about the content of this package, I hope you understand that is on a need-to-know basis.

Nevertheless, you have served the manor honorably. For that, you certainly ought to be rewarded.
96786-complete.title: The Syndicate Sting

96786-progress.name: Myrokos Silentform
96786-progress.text: Ah, $N, I see you've returned from Stromgarde.
96786-progress.title: The Syndicate Sting

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints
